## 3. Why the Newton-Schulz ITERATION has no numeric gate

The authors run Newton-Schulz in bfloat16 (`muon_plus.py:55`, `X = G.bfloat16()`);
we run f32. So `noise` below is the dtype difference the authors' own code carries,
and `signal` is what a 1e-4 RELATIVE error in `a` does to the output. A gate needs
signal >> noise.

```
$ python3 measure_ns_snr.py   # f32 control = the authors' arithmetic, dtype changed
./tests/oracle/.venv/bin/python: can't open file '/home/sehaxe/dormouse-wt/muon-oracle/vendor/dormouse-fused/crates/dormouse-muon-plus/tests/oracle/measure_ns_snr.py': [Errno 2] No such file or directory
```

## 3. Why the Newton-Schulz ITERATION has no numeric gate

The authors run Newton-Schulz in bfloat16 (`muon_plus.py:55`, `X = G.bfloat16()`);
we run f32. So `noise` below is the dtype difference the authors' own code carries,
and `signal` is what a 1e-4 RELATIVE error in `a` does to the output. A gate needs
signal >> noise.

## 4. the gate is proven able to fail

Four perturbations, each reverted, each expected to turn a test red. C2 is the
opposite: a perturbation the fixture is KNOWN not to see, recorded with the
reason, because a limit nobody wrote down is indistinguishable from a pass.

```
$ bash crates/dormouse-muon-plus/tests/oracle/falsify.sh
build_lock: ACQUIRED by 1872099 (muon-oracle)
=== A. one digit wrong in NS_COEFFS (2.0315 -> 2.0316) ===
DETECTED  NS_COEFFS last digit
          expected: the f32 nearest 2.0315 vs the f32 nearest 2.0316
thread 'ns_coeffs_are_the_authors_literal' (1872276) panicked at crates/dormouse-muon-plus/tests/muon_oracle.rs:158:5:
assertion `left == right` failed: NS_COEFFS (3.4445, -4.775, 2.0316) is not the f32 nearest to the authors' literal (3.4445, -4.775, 2.0315) at K1seki221/MuonPlus@8a9ace12 utils/optim/muon_plus.py:56
  left: (3.4445, -4.775, 2.0316)
 right: (3.4445, -4.775, 2.0315)

=== B. the composition order swapped: ColRow becomes row-then-col ===
  swapped 2 occurrences
DETECTED  ColRow composition order
          expected: max|ours - authors| on the col_row cases = 2.54e-1, i.e. the order signal
thread 'normalize_matches_the_authors_implementation' (1872559) panicked at crates/dormouse-muon-plus/tests/muon_oracle.rs:291:9:
ColRow on 16x8: max|ours - K1seki221/MuonPlus@8a9ace12 apply_post_polar_norm| = 2.542078e-1, bar 3e-5 (derivation: 16*k*u, k=32, u=2^-24, the f32 reassociation term)

=== C. the norm_col axis transposed: sum_dim(D-2) -> sum_dim(D-1) ===
  norm_col now reduces over the row axis
DETECTED  norm_col axis transposed
          expected: an O(1) difference: the authors unit-normalize columns, we would unit-normalize rows
thread 'normalize_matches_the_authors_implementation' (1872904) panicked at crates/dormouse-muon-plus/tests/muon_oracle.rs:291:9:
Col on 16x8: max|ours - K1seki221/MuonPlus@8a9ace12 apply_post_polar_norm| = 5.149305e-1, bar 3e-5 (derivation: 16*k*u, k=32, u=2^-24, the f32 reassociation term)

=== C2. the eps floor moved three decades (clamp_min(1e-7) -> 1e-4) ===
    EXPECTED TO STAY GREEN, and this is a statement about the FIXTURE, not a
    pass. The floor only binds when an axis norm falls between 1e-7 and 1e-4.
GREEN (as expected, and here is why)  the eps floor value
          every fixture axis norm is >= 2.0e-3 (grid values are k/498-1, k in 0..996), so the floor never binds and any floor in that range gives the identical output. It is also out of the authors' reach: their rule is sqrt(v^2+1e-7) with the epsilon INSIDE the root, ours is max(v,1e-7) outside it. Where the floor binds the two are different functions — at v=1e-6 they differ by 5e4 relative — so no single bar can be both tight enough to catch a transposed axis (C) and loose enough to admit tiny-norm inputs. Inputs with a tiny axis norm are therefore EXCLUDED, which is a stated limitation and not a silent hole.

=== D. the pinned upstream file is edited by one byte ===
DETECTED  the pin check
          expected: gen_oracle.py exits non-zero and says PIN ROTED
gen_oracle: PIN ROTED for utils/optim/muon_plus.py
  expected 665ea6cb1f6f631f7839c430f2f2c8cbd62dd7e6b8a24fb752f1211c57ab2cab
  got      29c7b439cdb9d9ccbc38a5d501344dcbe9e451c1475d1e63063664ad4fa721be

=== E. everything restored: the suite must be GREEN again ===
GREEN  the restore is clean
build_lock: RELEASED
```
